Answer: B
Reason: The initial X-ray (Fig. 1) demonstrates relatively clear lungs with only mild basal interstitial markings, while the follow-up X-ray (Fig. 2) shows significant progression to bilateral, patchy airspace opacities. This radiographic evolution from subtle findings to diffuse bilateral infiltrates is characteristic of viral pneumonias such as COVID-19, distinguishing it from the stable appearance of chronic heart failure or the typically more focal consolidation of bacterial pneumonia.
